name: asparagus
description: Three asparagus shoots with compact pointed buds, long stems and small attached scales.
useCase: Identify asparagus in recipes, groceries or produce selections.
misuse: Use a visible label when a fruit or vegetable identifies an ingredient, product or dietary choice.
